6:143.text: Eight pairs: of the sheep two
. Say: "Has He forbidden the two males or the two females, or
which the wombs of the two females enclose? Inform me with knowledge if you are truthful."

6:144.text: . Say: "Has He forbidden the two males or the two females or

which the wombs of the two females enclose? Or were you present when Allâh ordered you such a thing? Then who does more wrong than one who invents a lie against Allâh, to lead mankind astray without knowledge. Certainly Allâh guides not the people who are Zâlimûn

6:145.text: : "I find not in that which has been revealed to me anything forbidden to be eaten by one who wishes to eat it, unless it be Maitah
; for that surely is impure or impious
which is slaughtered as a sacrifice for others than Allâh
(or has been slaughtered for idols, or on which Allâh’s Name has not been mentioned while slaughtering)
. But whosoever is forced by necessity without wilful disobedience, nor transgressing due limits;
certainly, your Lord is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."

6:146.text: And unto those who are Jews, We forbade every
with undivided hoof, and We forbade them the fat of the ox and the sheep except what adheres to their backs or their entrails, or is mixed up with a bone. Thus We recompensed them for their rebellion
[committing crimes like murdering the Prophets and eating of Ribâ (usury)]
